title: Returns policy
text: You can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened electronics can be returned within 14 days provided all accessories and the original packaging are included. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 working days of the warehouse receiving the item. Items marked final sale, gift cards and opened personal-care products cannot be returned.

title: Warranty terms
text: Every product ships with a 2-year warranty covering manufacturing defects. Batteries are covered for 12 months. The warranty does not cover accidental damage, water ingress on non-waterproof models, or normal wear such as battery capacity decline. To make a claim, contact support with your order number and a photo of the fault; approved claims are repaired or replaced within 10 working days.

title: Shipping and delivery
text: Standard delivery is free on orders over 50 pounds and arrives in 3 to 5 working days. Express delivery costs 6.99 and arrives next working day if you order before 2pm. We deliver to the UK mainland, Northern Ireland and the Channel Islands; remote postcodes may add 2 days. If a parcel arrives damaged, photograph it and report it within 48 hours for a free replacement.

title: Account and billing
text: You can update your address, payment methods and marketing preferences from the account dashboard at any time. VAT invoices are available for every order under order history. If a payment fails, check that your card supports 3D Secure and that the billing postcode matches; you can retry payment from the order page for up to 7 days before the order is cancelled.

title: Headphones not charging
text: If your headphones will not charge, first try a different USB-C cable and a wall charger rated 5V. Clean the charging port gently with a dry cotton bud, as pocket lint is the most common cause. Hold the power button for 15 seconds to reset the device, then charge for at least 30 minutes before testing. If the LED still does not light, contact support for a warranty replacement.

title: Keyboard keeps disconnecting
text: A keyboard that drops connection is usually caused by wireless interference or low battery. Move the USB receiver to a front port away from metal objects, replace or recharge the batteries, and keep the keyboard within 10 metres of the receiver. On Bluetooth models, remove the device from your paired list and re-pair it. Updating the firmware from the support page fixes most remaining cases.

title: Student discount
text: Students with a verified university email receive 10 percent off full-price items. Verify once per academic year through the student portal; the discount applies automatically at checkout. It cannot be combined with other promo codes or sale prices, and excludes gift cards and final-sale items.

title: Trade-in programme
text: Trade in your old headphones, laptops or smartwatches for store credit. Answer a short condition questionnaire online, post the device free of charge, and receive credit within 7 days of inspection. Devices must power on and have no cracked screens for the standard valuation; accessories increase the offer.

title: Gift cards
text: Gift cards are delivered by email within minutes and never expire. They can be used across multiple orders and combined with promo codes. Lost gift card emails can be re-sent from your account; treat the code like cash, as we cannot replace cards redeemed by someone else.

title: Installing the video doorbell
text: Charge the doorbell fully before mounting. Use the included wedge to angle the camera toward your path, mount at about 1.2 metres high, and connect to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi during setup. The chime hub should be plugged in within 15 metres. Run the in-app signal test; two bars or more gives reliable motion alerts.

title: Privacy and your data
text: We collect only the data needed to fulfil orders and improve the store: contact details, order history and anonymised browsing analytics. We never sell personal data. You can download or delete your data at any time from the privacy dashboard, and marketing emails stop immediately when you unsubscribe.

title: Setting up the smart speaker
text: Plug in the speaker and wait for the pulsing light, then add it in the companion app over 2.4GHz Wi-Fi. Link your music accounts to enable voice playback, and create speaker groups for multiroom audio. If setup stalls, restart your router and keep the phone within 3 metres during pairing.

title: Our sustainability programme
text: Since 2023 we have cut packaging plastic by 82 percent by switching to moulded fibre and paper tape. Delivery routes are optimised nightly to reduce mileage, and 61 percent of last-mile deliveries in London are now made by electric van or cargo bike. Returned electronics are refurbished and resold rather than landfilled, and our repair centres fixed over 40,000 devices last year.

title: How our recommendation engine works
text: Product recommendations blend collaborative filtering over anonymised purchase histories with content signals such as category, price band and brand affinity. A nightly batch job retrains the model, while a real-time layer re-ranks suggestions based on the current browsing session. Customers can opt out of personalisation entirely from the privacy dashboard.

title: Supply chain and sourcing
text: We source from 140 audited suppliers across 18 countries. Every supplier signs our code of conduct covering fair wages, working hours and conflict minerals, and high-risk factories are audited annually by an independent third party. Key components are dual-sourced so that a disruption at one site never halts production.

title: Why we started the company
text: The company began in 2019 when the two founders could not find affordable, repairable tech accessories. They started by refurbishing returned electronics in a Birmingham garage, selling them with a proper warranty. That repair-first philosophy still shapes the business: every product page shows a repairability score and spare parts are stocked for 7 years.

title: Community and charity work
text: Each quarter, staff vote for a local charity to receive 1 percent of profits. Recent partners include food banks in Birmingham and Manchester and a digital-inclusion project donating refurbished laptops to schools. Employees get two paid volunteering days per year.

title: AI in customer support
text: Routine support questions are first handled by an assistant that retrieves answers from the help centre and drafts replies for human agents to approve. The assistant resolves about 35 percent of chats end to end, and every automated answer carries a feedback button whose ratings retrain the system weekly. Complex or sensitive cases always go straight to a human.
